tools.name: list_tickets
tools.title: List tickets
tools.description: Search and list tickets, newest first by default, with filters, sorting and paging. Rows are summaries; 'select' adds fields such as description, and get_ticket_brief has everything. For someone's queue use get_queue.

status.description: Only tickets in exactly this workflow state (Open, In Progress, Reopened, Resolved, Closed, or a custom state's label or ID). For every open or every closed ticket, use isResolved instead.

isResolved.description: true: only resolved tickets; false: only unresolved (any open state).

orderBy.description: Sort by: status, ticketNo, title, requestorName, requestorEmail, assigneeName, assigneeEmail, expectedDate, priority, createdDateTime, or lastInteraction.

select.description: Fields to add to each row, comma-separated: description, customFields, resolution, lastResolutionComment, createdBy, lastUpdatedBy, firstResponseOn, firstResolutionOn, lastResolutionOn, isFrtEscalated, isRtEscalated.

createdAfter.description: Created on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

createdBefore.description: Created before this day (YYYY-MM-DD). For one day: createdAfter=D, createdBefore=D+1.

expectedDateAfter.description: Due on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

lastUpdateAfter.description: Last updated on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

offset.description: Zero-based start for offset paging; ignored with continuationToken.

continuationToken.description: From the previous page, to get the next.

timezoneOffset.description: Your UTC offset in whole hours (default: the server's zone).

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.title: Create ticket
tools.description: Create a ticket, recorded as created by the caller. Only 'title' is required; the requestor defaults to the caller. People can be given by email or name, tags by text, custom fields by title. Call find_similar_tickets first to avoid a duplicate.

description.description: Plain-text description. Use descriptionHtml instead for formatting.

descriptionHtml.description: HTML description, used when 'description' isn't given. Script, forms, images and styles are removed; link a screenshot with add_ticket_link_attachments.

requestor.description: Who raised it (default: the caller). An email or name from the assignee list is enough; for anyone else pass id, name and email. For the email-to-ticket flow, put their email in all three.

id.description: Microsoft Entra object ID of the person. Only needed, with name and email, for someone outside the get_instance assignee list. For email-to-ticket requestors, use the email address in all three fields.

name.description: Display name. On its own, it is looked up in the assignee list (a unique partial match is enough).

email.description: Email address. On its own, it is looked up in the assignee list.

assignee.description: Assignee: an email or name from the assignee list.

id.description: Microsoft Entra object ID of the person. Only needed, with name and email, for someone outside the get_instance assignee list. For email-to-ticket requestors, use the email address in all three fields.

name.description: Display name. On its own, it is looked up in the assignee list (a unique partial match is enough).

email.description: Email address. On its own, it is looked up in the assignee list.

tagCategoryId.description: ID or name of the tag category (from list_tag_categories). Can be left out when the tag's text is in one category only.

text.description: Tag text as defined in the category (case doesn't matter).

customFields.description: Custom field values keyed by field ID or title (get_instance section 'customFields'): text or YYYY-MM-DD string, toggle boolean, list option keys or texts, people as {id,name,email} or an email.

timezoneOffset.description: Your UTC offset in whole hours (default: the server's zone).

tools.name: update_ticket
tools.title: Update ticket
tools.description: Change fields on a ticket; only those passed change. For its workflow state use update_ticket_status. addTags and removeTags keep the ticket's other tags; 'tags' replaces them all.

ticket.description: The ticket: its number (2213 or #2213) or its UUID.

descriptionHtml.description: New HTML description, used when 'description' isn't given. Script, forms, images and styles are removed.

requestor.description: New requestor: an email or name from the assignee list, or id, name and email for anyone else.

id.description: Microsoft Entra object ID of the person. Only needed, with name and email, for someone outside the get_instance assignee list. For email-to-ticket requestors, use the email address in all three fields.

name.description: Display name. On its own, it is looked up in the assignee list (a unique partial match is enough).

email.description: Email address. On its own, it is looked up in the assignee list.

assignee.description: New assignee: an email or name from the assignee list.

id.description: Microsoft Entra object ID of the person. Only needed, with name and email, for someone outside the get_instance assignee list. For email-to-ticket requestors, use the email address in all three fields.

name.description: Display name. On its own, it is looked up in the assignee list (a unique partial match is enough).

email.description: Email address. On its own, it is looked up in the assignee list.

tagCategoryId.description: ID or name of the tag category (from list_tag_categories). Can be left out when the tag's text is in one category only.

text.description: Tag text as defined in the category (case doesn't matter).

addTags.description: Tags to add, keeping the others.

tagCategoryId.description: ID or name of the tag category (from list_tag_categories). Can be left out when the tag's text is in one category only.

text.description: Tag text as defined in the category (case doesn't matter).

removeTags.description: Tags to remove, keeping the others.

tagCategoryId.description: ID or name of the tag category (from list_tag_categories). Can be left out when the tag's text is in one category only.

text.description: Tag text as defined in the category (case doesn't matter).

customFields.description: Custom field values keyed by field ID or title, checked against the field definitions.

timezoneOffset.description: Your UTC offset in whole hours (default: the server's zone).

tools.name: update_ticket_status
tools.title: Change ticket status
tools.description: Move a ticket to another workflow state (resolve, close, reopen...). Pass an allowedNextStatuses 'status' from get_ticket_brief; a step the workflow doesn't allow, or one needing a comment without one, is refused. When resolving, give a resolution.

ticket.description: The ticket: its number (2213 or #2213) or its UUID.

status.description: Target state: an allowedNextStatuses 'status' (a state or transition label also works).

resolution.description: When resolving: fixed, cannotResolve, or cancelled.

comment.description: Comment recorded with the change, which the requestor can see (some steps require one). For a private note, use add_ticket_comment.

timezoneOffset.description: Your UTC offset in whole hours (default: the server's zone).

tools.name: assign_ticket
tools.title: Assign ticket
tools.description: Assign a ticket to someone in the assignee list, by email or name (a unique partial name is enough).

ticket.description: The ticket: its number (2213 or #2213) or its UUID.

assignee.description: The new assignee's email or name.

timezoneOffset.description: Your UTC offset in whole hours (default: the server's zone).

tools.name: get_ticket_brief
tools.title: Get ticket brief
tools.description: Everything needed to act on one ticket, in one call: its details, allowedNextStatuses, who it is waiting on (waitingOn, idleDays), its latest activity (quoted email replies removed, long text cut) and attachments. activities=0 returns the details alone, in one request.

ticket.description: The ticket: its number (2213 or #2213) or its UUID.

activities.description: Latest activities to include (default 5, max 50; 0 for the details alone).

maxChars.description: Characters of text to keep in each activity and the description (defaults 400 and 1000; 20000 for the whole text, quoted email replies included).

includeAutomation.description: Include what automation rules did (default false).

timezoneOffset.description: Your UTC offset in whole hours (default: the server's zone).

tools.name: find_similar_tickets
tools.title: Find similar tickets
tools.description: Find tickets whose titles resemble a proposed one, ranked by shared keywords (score 0 to 1), to avoid a duplicate: call it before create_ticket, and comment on a match instead if it's the same problem. Unresolved tickets by default.

title.description: Proposed title, or a short description of the problem.

includeResolved.description: true to include resolved and closed tickets.

timezoneOffset.description: Your UTC offset in whole hours (default: the server's zone).

tools.name: get_queue
tools.title: Get a ticket queue
tools.description: A queue in one call: what's on my plate, someone else's, the team's, or the unassigned tickets, most urgent first, with who each is waiting on (waitingOn), days idle and SLA state. Open tickets by default; state=resolvedSince with 'since' lists what was resolved, for a standup.

who.description: me (default), a person's email or name, team (everyone's tickets), or unassigned.

role.description: assignee (default), requestor, or either: the tickets they're assigned or raised.

since.description: With state=resolvedSince: resolved on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

priority.description: Only this priority: Low, Medium, Important, or Urgent.

include.description: Per-row extras: waitingOn, idleDays, sla (the default for open tickets; none for resolvedSince), lastPublic (the latest public reply), counts (totals by assignee). waitingOn, idleDays and lastPublic read each row's history: one request per row.

sort.description: urgency (default: SLA breached, Urgent, Important, then waiting on the assignee longest), oldest, idle, or updated.

timezoneOffset.description: Your UTC offset in whole hours (default: the server's zone).

tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Show the account this server acts as: the signed-in user, or the configured service account for app-only callers and local (stdio) use. Ticket changes are attributed to it, and get_queue's 'me' is it.

tools.name: list_sla_risk
tools.title: List SLA risks
tools.description: List unresolved tickets that have breached or been escalated for their first-response (FRT) or resolution (RT) SLA, newest first, with the isFrtBreached, isRtBreached, isFrtEscalated, and isRtEscalated flags. If the instance has SLA tracking turned off, says so instead of listing nothing.

kind.description: any (default): breached or escalated; breached: breached only; escalated: escalated only.

priority.description: Only this priority: Low, Medium, Important, or Urgent.

createdAfter.description: Created on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

createdBefore.description: Created before this day (YYYY-MM-DD). For one day: createdAfter=D, createdBefore=D+1.

timezoneOffset.description: Your UTC offset in whole hours (default: the server's zone).

tools.name: count_tickets
tools.title: Count tickets
tools.description: Count tickets grouped by status, priority, or assignee, for questions like 'how many urgent tickets are open' or 'who has the most open tickets'. Unresolved tickets only by default. Returns groups sorted by count, largest first.

groupBy.description: Group by: status (default), priority, or assignee.

includeResolved.description: true to include resolved and closed tickets.

priority.description: Only this priority: Low, Medium, Important, or Urgent.

search.description: Only tickets matching this full-text search.

tags.description: Comma-separated tag filter in the form tagCategoryId_tagText (IDs from list_tag_categories).

createdAfter.description: Created on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

createdBefore.description: Created before this day (YYYY-MM-DD). For one day: createdAfter=D, createdBefore=D+1.

timezoneOffset.description: Your UTC offset in whole hours (default: the server's zone).

tools.name: preview_bulk_update
tools.title: Preview a bulk update
tools.description: Preview one change to many tickets (up to 50), picked by number or by filter: status, assignee, priority, tags, due date, and a comment. Changes nothing; says what would change on each ticket and which the workflow blocks, and returns a confirmToken for bulk_update.

tickets.description: The tickets, by number or UUID. Pass these or 'filter'.

filter.description: Pick the tickets by filter instead of 'tickets'.

titlePattern.description: Title pattern, * for any text: 'Weekly check:*'.

status.description: Only tickets in exactly this workflow state.

assignee.description: The assignee's email or name, or unassigned.

createdAfter.description: Created on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

createdBefore.description: Created before this day (YYYY-MM-DD). For one day: createdAfter=D, createdBefore=D+1.

includeResolved.description: true to include resolved and closed tickets (default: open ones only).

set.description: The change to make on every ticket.

status.description: Target workflow state, as update_ticket_status takes it.

resolution.description: With a resolving status: fixed, cannotResolve, or cancelled.

assignee.description: New assignee: an email or name from the assignee list.

addTags.description: Tags to add, keeping the others.

tagCategoryId.description: ID or name of the tag category (from list_tag_categories). Can be left out when the tag's text is in one category only.

text.description: Tag text as defined in the category (case doesn't matter).

removeTags.description: Tags to remove, keeping the others.

comment.description: A comment to add to every ticket.

isPrivate.description: Required: true for a private note to agents, false for a reply the requestor sees.

timezoneOffset.description: Your UTC offset in whole hours (default: the server's zone).

tools.name: bulk_update
tools.title: Apply a bulk update
tools.description: Apply a change previewed with preview_bulk_update, by its confirmToken alone, once the user has agreed. Tickets changed since the preview are skipped. Confirming the same token again returns the first result without changing anything.

tools.name: list_ticket_activities
tools.title: List ticket activities
tools.description: A ticket's activity history (comments, status and field changes), newest first, with quoted email replies removed and long text cut. Page back with continuationToken.

ticket.description: The ticket: its number (2213 or #2213) or its UUID.

continuationToken.description: From the previous page, to get older activity.

maxChars.description: Characters of each activity's text to keep (default 600; 20000 for the whole text, quoted email replies included).

tools.name: add_ticket_comment
tools.title: Add comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a ticket as the caller: plain text in 'comment', or formatted in 'commentHtml'. Say whether the requestor sees it: isPrivate true for an internal note, false for a reply they're notified of.

ticket.description: The ticket: its number (2213 or #2213) or its UUID.

isPrivate.description: true: an internal note only agents see. false: a public reply the requestor sees and is notified of.

commentHtml.description: HTML comment, used when 'comment' isn't given. Script, forms, images and styles are removed; link a screenshot with add_ticket_link_attachments.

tools.name: list_ticket_attachments
tools.title: List ticket attachments
tools.description: List the files and links attached to a ticket. A link's URL is included; a file's download URL (signed, short-lived) only with includeUrls.

ticket.description: The ticket: its number (2213 or #2213) or its UUID.

includeUrls.description: true to include files' download URLs.

timezoneOffset.description: Your UTC offset in whole hours (default: the server's zone).

tools.name: add_ticket_link_attachments
tools.title: Attach links
tools.description: Attach links (a SharePoint document, a web page, a screenshot's location) to a ticket, with an optional comment. Say whether the requestor sees them with isPrivate. Files can't be uploaded here.

ticket.description: The ticket: its number (2213 or #2213) or its UUID.

isPrivate.description: true: only agents see them. false: the requestor sees them too.

comment.description: Plain-text comment shown with the links.

commentHtml.description: HTML comment, used when 'comment' isn't given. Script, forms, images and styles are removed; for a screenshot, put a link to it in 'links'.

timezoneOffset.description: Your UTC offset in whole hours (default: the server's zone).

tools.name: get_instance
tools.title: Get ticketing instance settings
tools.description: The help desk's settings: custom fields (IDs, types, options, mandatory), the assignee list, workflow states and transitions, and SLA rules. Pass 'section' for just one part. Cached for a few minutes; refresh=true after a change.

section.description: all (default), customFields, assignees, workflows, or sla.

refresh.description: true to re-read the settings (at most once every 30 seconds).

timezoneOffset.description: Your UTC offset in whole hours (default: the server's zone).

tools.name: list_tag_categories
tools.title: List tag categories
tools.description: The tag categories and the tags in each. Writes take a tag by its text (and category, when the text is in more than one); the list_tickets 'tags' filter needs tagCategoryId_tagText.

refresh.description: true to re-read the tags (at most once every 30 seconds).
